name: Capacities
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Capacities, organize linked notes as typed objects such as people, books, meetings, and ideas. The hard boundary is object-model polish, mobile capture, sync, calendar integration, and ai features, plus sync, collaboration, and capture polish.
